# durantic_image (Resource)

Manages a Durantic image — a container image that machine roles install onto machines. Official images are managed by Durantic and cannot be changed or deleted through this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Minimal example — a public image
resource "durantic_image" "minimal" {
  name             = "my-app"
  docker_image_url = "registry.example.com/team/my-app:1.2.3"
}

# Full example — a private image pulled with a registry credential
resource "durantic_registry_credential" "example" {
  name         = "my-registry"
  registry_url = "registry.example.com"
  username     = "myuser"
  password     = var.registry_password
}

resource "durantic_image" "example" {
  name                     = "my-private-app"
  docker_image_url         = "registry.example.com/team/my-private-app:1.2.3"
  description              = "Private application image"
  registry_credential_uuid = durantic_registry_credential.example.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `docker_image_url` (String) Docker/OCI image URL (e.g. `registry.example.com/team/app:1.2.3`).
- `name` (String) Name of the image.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the image.
- `registry_credential_uuid` (String) UUID of the `durantic_registry_credential` used to pull the image. Leave unset for images that need no authentication.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the image was created.
- `is_official` (Boolean) Whether this is an official Durantic image.
- `registry_credential_name` (String) Name of the registry credential used to pull the image, if any.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the image was last updated.
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the image.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import durantic_image.example <UUID>
```
